tower.method: Independent all-yaw AABB sweep sampled <=0.25WU; support heights use .15WU disk samples and include cover tops. Deck/pole/rider volumes separate. Nominal proposal slabs, not live ranked route generation.

tidewater.method: Static isolated model only. Seam graph is geometry derived; route sampling at <=0.25WU. Conservative circular footprint r=.675 and height1.6. Not game Actor, native collision or human playtest.
